steps.content:
You can buy from either one. The two listings are identical on everything I could see.

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Box contents | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |
| Colour | Graphite | Graphite |

The pages give no reason to prefer one seller. The matching rating and review count may mean the reviews are for the product and not the seller. If so, they tell you nothing about either seller's reliability.

Before you buy, you could check a few things outside these pages:
- **Seller reputation:** Look for independent reviews of Brackmoor Sound and Ottervale Audio, such as on Trustpilot or Reddit.
- **Warranty:** Check whether the seller or the manufacturer honors it. Also check whether the seller is an authorized retailer.
- **Final price:** Compare the total at checkout. Tax or fees can differ even when the listed prices match.

If those checks turn up nothing, pick either one. Nothing on the listings favors one over the other.
